finding.claim: With the Embed extension enabled and allowed_domains left at its default ([]), any standalone https:// line in a Markdown document causes a server-side fetch to an arbitrary host, and the fetched remote HTML is emitted raw, bypassing html_input.
finding.source: Document body: a line consisting solely of an https:// URL (src/Extension/Embed/EmbedStartParser.php:34,47-51).
finding.sink: Outbound HTTP request via OscaroteroEmbedAdapter::updateEmbeds (src/Extension/Embed/Bridge/OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:43) and raw HTML output via EmbedRenderer::render (src/Extension/Embed/EmbedRenderer.php:33).

trace.note: Accepts any line starting with https://
Creates EmbedParser/Embed node for the URL
Passes all top-level embeds to the adapter
DomainFilteringAdapter only wraps the adapter when allowed_domains is non-empty; default [] (line 28) skips it
Stores remote code->html on the node
Returns embed code unescaped; no HtmlFilter applied

finding.guards_checked: allowed_domains default is [] so DomainFilteringAdapter is not applied (EmbedExtension.php:28,39-41). https:// prefix restricts scheme only, not host (EmbedStartParser.php:34). html_input (HtmlBlockRenderer.php:44-46, HtmlInlineRenderer.php:44) is not applied to embed output. allow_unsafe_links is not applied to embed output. Impact: SSRF to any https host (including internal hosts) with metadata reflected in output; if the remote page supplies oEmbed/meta HTML (embed/embed library behavior, not verified here), stored XSS even when html_input is escape or strip. Severity high when embed is enabled without allowed_domains. Not verified by execution: no shell or PHP runtime available.

finding.claim: DomainFilteringAdapter may check a different host than the one the embed library fetches, so an allowlisted suffix could pass for an attacker host (possible parser differential; unverified).
finding.source: Embed URL from the document (src/Extension/Embed/EmbedStartParser.php:39), e.g. https://evil.com\.allowed.com.
finding.sink: Outbound fetch by the embed library using the original URL string (src/Extension/Embed/Bridge/OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:43).

trace.note: Link destination parsed; backslash handling not verified
Host lowercased and trailing dot stripped
Suffix match against allowed domain with '.' boundary
Library fetches original URL; its host parsing may differ from parse_url

finding.guards_checked: Scheme restricted to http/https (DomainFilteringAdapter.php:47). Trailing dot stripped (:52). Suffix match requires '.' boundary (:55). Parser differential not reproduced: PHP and the embed library were not run here, and the library source is not in the repo. Severity medium if confirmed; only applies when allowed_domains is set.

finding.claim: Defaults allow raw HTML (html_input=allow) and unsafe link schemes (allow_unsafe_links=true), so consumers rendering untrusted Markdown must opt into safer settings.

trace.note: Unsafe href permitted when allow_unsafe_links is true

finding.guards_checked: Unsafe-protocol check exists (RegexHelper.php:251-259) but is only enforced when allow_unsafe_links is false. Documented default behavior, not a code bug. Informational.
